LanguageData.CC_Settings_Hint: Defaults: each room type belongs to one cleaning column; use the arrows to move it. Rooms of that type land in that column unless you move the individual room in the Cleaning tab. The custom zone is painted from Architect > Zone.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_Hint: Every enclosed room on this map, sorted into cleaning columns by its room type. Use the arrows or right-click a room to move it to another column; left-click a room to jump to it.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_DefaultsTip: Open the mod settings to change which column each room type lands in by default.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_PinnedYes: Pinned to this column (*). Right-click and pick Automatic to unpin.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_PinnedNo: Placed automatically by room type (default column: {0}).
LanguageData.CC_DesignatorCustomZoneExpandDesc: Paint the custom cleaning zone. Filth inside it is cleaned by the "custom" work column, even outside the home area.
LanguageData.CC_DesignatorCustomZoneClearDesc: Remove cells from the custom cleaning zone.
